newsitem.title: UK: Nat Express E. Midlands Q4 passengers fall.
newsitem.headline: Nat Express E. Midlands Q4 passengers fall.

text.p: National Express Group Plc said on Wednesday that its East Midlands Airport passenger numbers for the fourth quarter to December 1996 fell 1.9 percent to 367,000.
East Midlands' annual passenger numbers for the whole year fell 3.2 percent to 1,824,000 in 1996, it said.
The company said the decline was smaller than what was previously expected.
Air cargo and mail rose 33.7 percent to 32,500 tonnes in the fourth quarter while it rose 24.2 percent to 116,000 tonnes during the whole year.
Air transport movements rose 4.8 percent to 9,900 tonnes in the fourth quarter and by eight percent to 42,700 tonnes during the whole year.
